item.title: Indian Gaming Association Meets with Arizona Tribal Leaders to Strengthen Unity and Confront Threats from Prediction Markets
item.description: Phoenix, Arizona —The Indian Gaming Association (IGA) met last week with the Tribal leaders of the Arizona Indian Gaming Association (AIGA) to renew a long-standing partnership and reinforce a shared commitment to protecting Tribal sovereignty. The gathering continues the outreach efforts established by the late Chairman Ernie Stevens, Jr., whose leadership shaped much of today’s national Tribal gaming landscape. IGA Chairman David ... item.title: Indian Gaming Association Chairman David Z. Bean Honors Native Youth at UNITY’s 50th Anniversary Kickoff Breakfast
item.description: SEATTLE, WA — November 18, 2025 — The Indian Gaming Association Chairman, David Z. Bean, delivered the keynote address at the UNITY 50th Anniversary Kickoff Breakfast at the Sheraton Grand Seattle, where he joined Native youth, advisors, and UNITY alumni in celebrating five decades of leadership and community strength.
